definitions.def: a state of internal balance the body always seeks
to become larger in number or amount
a normal or starting level used as a point of comparison
a feeling of happiness or enjoyment

grammar_choice.en_template: Let's look at {{1:what/that}} is occurring in your brain when {{2:scrolling/scrolled}} on social media, a quick dopamine activity.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 소셜 미디어에서 스크롤할 때, 즉 빠른 도파민 활동을 할 때 여러분의 뇌에서 무슨 일이 일어나는지 살펴보자.
explain: look at의 목적어 명사절 + 절 안 주어 역할 → 관계대명사/의문사 what.
주어(you)가 스크롤을 '하는' 능동·진행 → 분사 scrolling(when scrolling).

grammar_choice.en_template: You open your social media apps and immediately you notice you feel really good, your dopamine levels {{1:increase/increases}} incredibly fast and pleasure {{2:is experienced/experiences}} in your brain.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 여러분이 소셜 미디어 앱을 열면 즉시 기분이 정말 좋다는 것을 알아차리고, 도파민 수치가 믿을 수 없을 만큼 빠르게 증가하며 뇌에서 즐거움이 경험된다.
explain: 주어 your dopamine levels(복수) → 동사 increase.

grammar_choice.en_template: The challenge this creates is as with everything in our universe: as the laws of physics explain, 'what goes up, {{1:must/musts}} {{2:come/comes}} down'.

explain: 조동사 must는 수·인칭 변화 없음 → must.

grammar_choice.en_template: Your brain and body are always seeking something {{1:called/calling}} 'homeostasis', {{2:which/what}} simply means balance.

grammar_choice.en_template: With this in mind, when dopamine levels increase incredibly fast when scrolling social media, the brain then thinks, 'Wow, {{1:how/what}} are my dopamine levels {{2:so/such}} high?'

grammar_choice.en_template: In order {{1:to achieve/achieving}} homeostasis, or balance, the dopamine then has to quickly drop an equal amount below your baseline level in order to rebalance, {{2:making/made}} you feel even worse than before you started scrolling.

jumble.answer: Let's look at what is occurring in your brain when scrolling on social media, a quick dopamine activity.
You open your social media apps and immediately you notice you feel really good, your dopamine levels increase incredibly fast and pleasure is experienced in your brain.
The challenge this creates is as with everything in our universe: as the laws of physics explain, 'what goes up, must come down'.
Your brain and body are always seeking something called 'homeostasis', which simply means balance.
With this in mind, when dopamine levels increase incredibly fast when scrolling social media, the brain then thinks, 'Wow, how are my dopamine levels so high?'

In order to achieve homeostasis, or balance, the dopamine then has to quickly drop an equal amount below your baseline level in order to rebalance, making you feel even worse than before you started scrolling.
